## Why This Is Asked

This question probes real-time streaming performance under backpressure, a common Tesla/Microsoft scenario.

## Key Concepts

- End-to-end latency budgets from edge to dashboard
- Backpressure, broker lag, consumer group behavior
- Autoscaling signals and failure modes (broker outage, partition, slow consumers)

## Code Example

```javascript
// simple p95 latency estimator from samples
function p95(samples){
  const s=[...samples].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  return s[Math.floor(0.95*(s.length-1))];
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you isolate ingress bottlenecks vs. processing bottlenecks?
- How would you validate autoscaler decisions under burst traffic?
- What metrics would you ship to tracing/observability systems?
